description: Generate or refresh the buying committee DealMap for a prospect. DealMaps are family-grain: a subsidiary ticker resolves upward to the corporate family (a generate that resolves to a cached family map is not charged) and the response names the family. Maps the org structure and assigns stakeholder roles (Economic Buyer, Decision Maker, Champion, etc.) using AI analysis. Conditionally billed: successful results cost 10 credits for generation_source=org_fresh or org_fresh_empty, including a fresh empty org result supplemented with people. Cached results (org_cache or annotated_cache_hit) are free and reused when available. Limited to 5 generation requests per minute; respect Retry-After on 429 responses. After a timeout, check get_dealmap before retrying; completion is not guaranteed. Avoid force_refresh unless the user explicitly requests it. Requires "outreach" scope on the API key.

force_refresh.description: Force fresh org chart fetch. Use sparingly — consumes credits.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (subsidiary tickers resolve to the corporate family)

name: generate_dealmap
